description: State-start to terminal state, single trajectory, warmed shuffled timings
initialization: Exact two constant states on either side of x=0.5
cfl_method: Same domain/grid/case-dependent step count for each numerical flux
outflow: Transmissive on both ends; analytic waves do not reach the boundary

provenance.accuracy_target: Per-case componentwise terminal mean absolute errors of the filtered Newton N=256 control with 1e-8 m depth tolerance, multiplied by 1.05
provenance.timing_statistic: Median across seven shuffled single-trajectory calls by default; p25/p75 are within-run interquartiles. C allocation, interface work, cell updates and the Python-to-C call are included. Python input reset and reference are untimed.
